06 Substance use and other · class card

Other agents

modafinil · armodafinil · phentermine

Key point
  • Modafinil and its R-enantiomer armodafinil are non-amphetamine wake-promoting drugs the board's first-line choice for narcolepsy sleepiness
  • Phentermine is a sympathomimetic that releases norepinephrine weight loss; contraindicated in cardiovascular disease, hypertension and heart failure In practiceIn practice: the label lists uncontrolled hypertension, with coronary artery disease, stroke, arrhythmias and congestive heart failure.
  • Modafinil induces cytochrome P450 3A4 (CYP3A4) hormonal contraceptive levels fall a second method is needed
Drugs

Modafinil Provigil: the wake-promoting drug the board asks about

Armodafinil Nuvigil: the R-enantiomer of modafinil, same uses and warnings

Phentermine: sympathomimetic appetite suppressant for obesity

Phentermine-topiramate Qsymia: the combination, for long-term weight reduction; topiramate's own effects are on its card

Mechanism

Modafinil: exact action unclear more orexin and monoamine signaling wakefulness

Wakes like amphetamine or methylphenidate, though its drug profile differs

Phentermine: norepinephrine release appetite suppression weight loss; an amphetamine-like amine

Uses

Narcolepsy daytime sleepiness: first line; amphetamines and methylphenidate are second line

Hypersomnolence disorder (first line) and sleepiness at work in shift work disorder

Obstructive sleep apnea: leftover sleepiness only, never in place of treating the obstruction

Obesity: phentermine for weight loss; most patients regain the weight after stopping In practiceIn practice: phentermine alone is labeled as a short-term adjunct of a few weeks, alongside diet, exercise and behavior change; tolerance to the appetite effect usually comes within a few weeks, and the drug is then stopped. The topiramate combination is labeled for long-term use.

Adverse effects

Modafinil: headache, nausea, nervousness, anxiety, insomnia

Serious rash, Stevens-Johnson syndrome included: stop modafinil at the first sign Modafinil labelToxic epidermal necrolysis and drug rash with eosinophilia and systemic symptoms are also reported; suspected angioedema or anaphylaxis also means stopping.

Psychiatric symptoms: caution after psychosis, depression or mania

Phentermine: palpitations, tachycardia, raised blood pressure, ischemic events; rarely primary pulmonary hypertension or valvular heart disease

Abuse potential: modafinil and phentermine are Schedule IV

Weight-loss drug in heart diseaseNorepinephrine release raises heart rate and blood pressure; ischemic events are reported

If a patient with coronary disease, heart failure or uncontrolled hypertension asks for a weight-loss drug, choose any option other than phentermine.

Interactions, by result
Combined withResultRule
Hormonal contraceptives such as ethinyl estradiol, with modafinil or armodafinilLower contraceptive levels from CYP3A4 inductionAdd or switch to another method; window in the timeline
Cyclosporine, midazolam, triazolam, with modafinilLower blood levelsConsider a dose change
Monoamine oxidase inhibitor (MAOI), current or recent, with phentermine Hypertensive crisisContraindicated; washout on the MAOI card
Insulin or oral hypoglycemics, with phentermineGlucose-lowering needs may changeA lower dose may be needed
Monitoring
WhenCheckWhy
Before phentermineHeart disease, uncontrolled hypertension, hyperthyroidism, glaucoma, agitation, drug abuse, MAOI useEach one contraindicates it
Phentermine-topiramate, before and monthlyPregnancy testMay cause fetal harm; contraindicated in pregnancy, as is phentermine alone
On phentermineNew dyspnea, angina, syncope or leg edemaPossible pulmonary hypertension: stop the drug
On modafinilSleepiness before drivingSleepiness can persist
Where the choice is made

Narcolepsy, hypersomnolence and shift work disorder: diagnosis and treatment plan

Amphetamines and methylphenidate: second-line wake drugs, also used for attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder (ADHD)

Topiramate's own adverse effects

MAOI washout before or after another drug

Practice
  1. 26-year-old woman with narcolepsy starting modafinil for daytime sleep attacks takes a combined estrogen-progestin pill daily wants no pregnancy for the next 2 years blood pressure normal · no migraine · normal examination → Use a second contraceptive method → modafinil induces cytochrome P450 3A4, the enzyme that clears ethinyl estradiol, so contraceptive levels fall; a backup or alternative method is used on the drug and for a time after it stops
  2. 54-year-old man with obesity, body mass index 36 coronary artery disease with a stent placed 2 years ago asks for a pill to help him lose weight blood pressure 128/78 mm Hg · no chest pain · fasting glucose normal → Phentermine → a sympathomimetic that releases norepinephrine, raising heart rate and blood pressure; coronary artery disease contraindicates it, while diet and activity are the base of any weight-loss plan
  3. 31-year-old night-shift nurse with shift work disorder started modafinil 3 weeks ago for sleepiness at work now fever, a spreading red rash and painful mouth sores temperature 38.6 °C · target-like lesions on the trunk · oral erosions → Stop modafinil → serious rash, Stevens-Johnson syndrome included, is a label warning for modafinil, and the drug is stopped at the first rash unless another cause is clear
